prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create high-fidelity Chinese desktop UI product concept for CCLink Studio, wide landscape image. Dark charcoal #1e1e1e/#252526 VS Code-inspired flat panels, restrained blue #1687d9, extremely readable Chinese type, generous spacing, realistic desktop density, simple outline icons, no decorative gradients. These are proposed interfaces using example data. Critical product rule: a workspace is a typed project; its sidebar/home are preset by project type. Work modes are DOCUMENT/CONTENT LAYOUTS (Markdown, browser, 3D), NOT business categories. ABSOLUTELY NO second horizontal navigation of business modes like 经营/内容/电路/结构. Top navigation ONLY specific project names. No global account/role/database/MCP activity rail. Footer outside UI 'v0.2 产品设计提案 · 示例内容 · 尚未实现此布局'. Design board with TWO large app windows side by side with equal widths. Overall title '项目有类型，打开就有合适的首页'. LEFT caption '日记项目 · 我的空间'. Top tabs '我的空间' selected, '我的公司', '眼镜研发', '+'. Sidebar heading '我的空间' small badge '日记项目'. Business entries '今天' selected, '日记', '计划', '定时整理'. Below divider '文件', '会话', '工具'. Bottom gear '设置'. Main diary home header '今天 · 11 月 18 日' with blue action '继续写今日日记'. A document preview heading '今日记录', subsection '昨日回顾' with sentence '完成外壳初稿，供电方案待确认。', subsection '今日待做' with two unchecked rows '核对供电方案', '整理本周计划'. Below concise section '定时整理' rows '每日简报 · 查看任务' and '每周计划和总结 · 查看任务'. Footer subtle '已关联原日记目录'. Do not show fake AI completed results. RIGHT caption '公司项目 · 星河公司'. Same app top tabs '我的空间', '星河公司' selected, '眼镜研发', '+'. Sidebar heading '星河公司' badge '公司项目'. Entries '公司概览' selected, '业务项目', '公司账目', '运营内容'; common divider entries '文件', '会话', '工具'; bottom gear '设置'. Center header '星河公司', small text '继续处理公司的项目与经营事务'. Modest section '业务项目' with two cards '智能眼镜' and 'Studio', each link '查看项目 →'. Next section '需要处理' two rows '核对本月支出 · 打开账目', '研发记录草稿 · 继续编辑'. Final section '运营内容' with text links '文章发布' and '视频创作'. No fake financial metrics. Tiny top right icon on each app permits opening Agent but both homes prioritize content. Both show a restrained bottom statusbar '本地资料' and 'Git'. Distinct business sidebars, identical outer shell. Accounts and roles are ABSENT from these sidebars.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create high-fidelity Chinese desktop UI product concept for CCLink Studio, wide landscape image. Dark charcoal #1e1e1e/#252526 VS Code-inspired flat panels, restrained blue #1687d9, extremely readable Chinese type, generous spacing, realistic desktop density, simple outline icons, no decorative gradients. These are proposed interfaces using example data. Critical product rule: a workspace is a typed project; its sidebar/home are preset by project type. Work modes are DOCUMENT/CONTENT LAYOUTS (Markdown, browser, 3D), NOT business categories. ABSOLUTELY NO second horizontal navigation of business modes like 经营/内容/电路/结构. Top navigation ONLY specific project names. No global account/role/database/MCP activity rail. Footer outside UI 'v0.2 产品设计提案 · 示例内容 · 尚未实现此布局'. One large settings window with small business-use inset on the right. Title '账号、角色等管理进入设置，选择与使用留在工作中'. Main settings window occupies 78% width. Header '设置', search field '搜索设置', scope pills '应用' selected and '当前项目：星河公司'. Left navigation clearly grouped and readable: group '连接' entries '网站与账号' SELECTED, '模型与 API', 'Git 与数据连接'; group '助手' entries '角色', 'Skills 与 MCP'; group '环境' entries '组件与设备'; group '应用' entries '外观与编辑', '用量与诊断', '更新与关于'. Main content title '网站与账号', description '统一管理网站账号；各项目按需关联使用'. Blue button '添加账号'. Table columns '账号', '网站', '关联项目', '操作'. Example rows '星河工作室 | 博客园 | 星河公司 | 管理', '个人账号 | 内容网站 | 我的空间 | 管理'. A lower subsection titled '账号详情' with labels '所属网站：博客园', '显示名称：星河工作室', button '打开登录页面', and quiet text '凭证保留在本机，不写入项目文件'. No actual secrets shown. Below main content a clearly framed second compact preview titled '角色管理' showing two role items '默认助手' and '研发助手' with '编辑' buttons, caption '定义与维护放在设置'. On the remaining right 22% width two compact annotated BUSINESS UI snippets: top '文章发布' shows field '发布账号' selector '星河工作室 ▾' link '管理账号 ↗'; bottom 'Agent 输入区' shows selector '角色：研发助手 ▾', input '结合当前文件提问…', link '管理角色 ↗'. Thin arrows from settings to snippets. At bottom note '设置维护资源，工作页面直接选用'. Also a slim separate row labeled '当前项目设置' with '项目类型 · 资料位置 · 账号关联 · Git'. Do not imply role creation grants permissions or copies accounts. No mode navigation.
